I ordered this for my Kenmore gas range because everything on it was working fine except for the oven. Sometimes it would light, sometimes it wouldn't. Even when it did light, I would have to wait about 30 seconds for the gas to turn on and ignite. When I researched the problem, this part appeared to be the most likely culprit. If it doesn't reach a high enough temperature, the gas to the oven won't turn on. The old part would either take about 30 seconds to get hot enough, or it wouldn't get hot enough and prevented the oven from lighting.

It probably took me a little longer to install (about 30 minutes) than it would most people because the wires on the old part didn't have any excess length, which made them harder to reach when splicing the wires together. Fortunately, the wires on the replacement part were long, so that was not an issue.

Once I got it back together and turned it on, I knew almost immediately it was going to work. The new part lit up much quicker and brighter than the old one. Within 10 seconds I heard the gas turn on and ignite. I've used the oven every day since installing this and it's the same every time.

I'm very happy to have my oven working every time I want to use it. This part did the job and I would recommend it to anyone needing one.
